status: optional bounded contact-damper proxy; not adopted by full piano backend

math.ledger_identity: string port work + board work + hammer kinetic change + contact potential change + contact loss + damper loss = external force work
math.resistance_control: Rd=2Z*strength*closure^2; closure target=0 for key down, otherwise 1-pedal; default exponential lift1ms/return10ms
math.pedal_convention: pedal1 sustain depressed/dampers lifted; pedal0 lets dampers return on released keys
math.dynamic_storage: none; control/bypass changes neither mechanical state nor accumulated work

report.scope: One key per case, 1 polarization, identical choir lines, original 475-mode board; raw board-only pressure, no final radiation calibration

probe.timing_limit: includes energy scans, one key only; not callback or whole-keyboard qualification

limits: Contact shunt is an authored proxy at the hammer position, not real damper location or geometry, felt dynamics, or measured half-pedal behavior.
Friction energy is dissipated; damper reaction and noise through the body are absent. Existing bridge coupling remains reciprocal.

First strike has no pre-roll: the 1 ms opening removes 0.00784 J for C2 and 0.00475 J for C4 even with sustain pedal 1, because the initially closed load opens while the near-string launch omits real hammer travel.
No unison detuning or common-loss network, secondary polarization, or calibrated direct string radiation. Raw board-only WAV peaks may exceed full scale.
Bounded C2/C4 at 48 kHz only. No full-keyboard, backend, Reason, calibration, or default integration; no realism, price, or realtime claim.
